## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys when storing cache entries — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `get("ALPHA")` returns `None`. You store the original key, but `get` always looks up `key.lower()`; the round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. — Callers writing mixed-case keys cannot retrieve their cached values, breaking the cache’s documented case-insensitive behavior.
